ios.desc:
Place your puzzle tiles and see them come alive as the sun rises, the leaves rattle, the owl hoots and the squirrel giggles. Each animal will reveal its cute little sound when you tap on them.

FEATURES
- Animals make sounds when puzzle tile is placed and when tapped on
- Many little animations keep things fun (e.g. opening barn door, rattling trees, spinning flowers)
- High quality illustrations. Each puzzle has been hand drawn by amazing artists from all over the world
- Usability tested and optimized specifically for toddlers (e.g. auto adjusting of inaccurate taps, allow dragging while the other hand is still on the touch screen)

IS IT REALLY FREE?
Yes, it really is. I'm a new parent and rebuilt this based on a previous project for my son to play. There's no in app purchase, no tracking or any other BS. If your child enjoys the game, would love to hear back from you.

quotes.text:
To put another data point out there: I recently released a little kids puzzle game[1]. I payed a friend to help out with the coding, contracted out illustrations and purchased the sounds from stock sound services. I've put in around 10k$ to develop the app and it's generating around 2$/day. It will take me roughly 13-14years to break even :)

However I also see the app as a advertising for my consultation business and plan to use it to cross promote my next kids app[2], so it's hard to figure out the real cost/benefit structure.

[1] Animal Puzzle - http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/kids-animal-puzzle/id540512136?mt=8

[2] ToddlerTube - http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=4504690
quotes.story_title: As Boom Lures App Creators, Tough Part Is Making a Living
